D=1+sigma_p*(k_p+T_e/T_V)>0 is the static-loop denominator. clip(v,L,U)=min(U,max(L,v)); DB(v)=v-delta_db for v>delta_db, v+delta_db for v<-delta_db and zero otherwise; F(v)=k_servo_pos*v for v>=0 and k_servo_neg*v otherwise. Proj(x,v,L,U)=0 for outward motion at either bound, otherwise v. Initial x_X,x_S are in [-1,1], y_T,y_D in [0,1]; four z memories are finite and free. Constraint-preserving integration enforces bounds. T_ip,T_V,T_b,T_x,T_s,T_n,T_drr,sigma_p,k_servo_pos,k_servo_neg>0; k_p,T_e,k_d,T_a,k_x,T_m,k_drr,delta_db>=0. 0<=L_open<U_open<=1,L_rate<0<U_rate,L_bypass<U_bypass. All parameters and inputs are finite locally bounded. d_0,t_hdrr,k_drrv are fixed biases. Signals use compatible normalized speed, control and full-travel opening bases; time is seconds and servo slopes inverse seconds."}
